nodes.text: Möbius is a new kind of app — built on the premise that what matters to you should get deeper over time, not disappear into a feed. One place for the friendships, communities, and continuities that define your life.
Everything you contribute builds into something. Nothing scrolls away. Return to any relationship and find it deeper than you left it.
Your data lives on your device. The server coordinates — it can't read your content. Not by policy. By cryptography.
Designed for presence, not retention. No engagement metrics. No attention economy. The economics are aligned with depth, not volume.
“An online place to hang out with friends and friends-of-friends with no ads or brands or influencers or 'algorithm.'”
Bluesky · April 2026 — describing exactly this, three days before they knew it existed
This isn't just a different app — it's a different . See why it's built this way.
